participation.context: Said the name twice and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the chronicle's old man has a name and still no speech

story.body: You had talked to nobody for seven hours. You said the name twice and stopped. You did not follow it with a line.

relations.note: the chronicle's old man has a name and still no speech
the comedy without marriages stays unsaid

story.body: You heard the oath set against the wedding, and you did not offer the comedy you have already written. The cup stayed the whole of your part.

relations.note: the comedy without marriages stays unsaid

title: Heard the dispute and kept to the cup

participation.context: Tied the parcel and left the questions as questions.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the questions are for his chronicle, and they are not yet a play

story.body: You repaired the parcel and put three questions on a small sheet while supper was slow. You did not turn any question into a speech.

relations.note: the questions are for his chronicle, and they are not yet a play

title: Wrote three questions and retied the parcel
